info.name: MovieDB
info.summary: Personal movie database to track your watched movies
info.description:
# MovieDB - Personal Movie Database
Track all the movies you've watched with rich metadata from TMDB.
## Features
- **Movie Tracking**: Log movies with where you watched them (Netflix, Disney+, cinema, etc.) - **TMDB Integration**: Automatically fetch movie posters, cast, and plot information - **Personal Ratings**: Rate movies 1-10 and write your own reviews - **Watch History**: Track when you watched each movie and in what language - **Watchlist**: Maintain a list of movies you want to watch, with priorities and a random picker - **Filtering & Sorting**: Filter by genre, platform and favorites, and sort in either direction - **Statistics**: See your viewing stats by genre, platform, and more
## Getting Started
1. Get a free API key from [TMDB](https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api) 2. Enter your API key in the app settings 3. Start adding movies to your collection!
